company.description: Mars Auto is developing autonomous trucks to completely automate warehouse to warehouse truck operations.The startup is developing autonomous trucks for the $50 billion Korean trucking market. The goal is to fully automate warehouse to warehouse truck operations to save the trucking market billions. The company has two LOIs with two of the largest logistic businesses in Korea.
